# Phase 6 evaluation findings (generated by `phase_6/eval_final.py`; do not edit by hand)

Common protocol: 128 held-out gaps of the pivot song (16 per band x gap length 1-4), identical for every checkpoint (holdout ranges asserted equal across runs); tokens from the original ungapped source; fp32, batch 1, greedy codebook decoding. Condition A = clean context, C = whole song re-encoded with a real-like zeroed span (deployment). Mean +- 95% CI over examples.

Checkpoint steps: `phase6_final_songs17_seed43/final` 300,000, `phase6_final_songs17_seed43/best_val` 30,000, `phase6_final_songs17_seed43/best_audio` 210,000, `phase6_final_songs17_seed43/step_100000` 100,000, `phase6_final_songs17_seed43/step_200000` 200,000, `phase3_songs17_seed43/final` 300,000, `phase3_songs17_seed43/best_val` 20,000, `phase3_songs17_seed44/final` 300,000, `phase3_songs17_seed44/best_val` 280,000, `phase1_songs17/best_val` 950,000
